meaning: Stage 1, 'God exists', with the skeleton's IsGod linked to the Summa's God through the fuller nominal definition (owner decisions on #143, 2026-10-24): the predicate that definition applies is IsGod itself, since a being that meets what the name signifies is God in the proper sense of the name (q.2 a.2 ad 2, q.13 a.8 ad 2). There is a first mover moved by none (prima via, excluded-middle instance) and something maximal in being (quarta via). The maximum is God by version (a) (AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-MAXIME-ENS-IS-GOD-VIA-FULL-DESCRIPTION), and the first mover is that maximum (AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-FIRST-MOVER-IS-MAXIME-ENS), so the first mover is God. The bare identification premise STMT-UNIQUE-PURE-ACT-FIRST-MOVER-IS-GOD, the pure-act bridges and q.11 a.3 are not used.
